0.long_answer: IgA nephropathy, also known as Berger's disease, is a form of glomerulonephritis that commonly presents with episodes of hematuria, particularly following an upper respiratory tract infection. This condition is important to distinguish from thin basement membrane disease, which also presents with hematuria but is typically a benign condition characterized by thinned glomerular basement membranes on electron microscopy and has an excellent long-term prognosis. In contrast, IgA nephropathy may lead to persistent proteinuria and can potentially progress to chronic kidney disease, warranting careful clinical evaluation and management.
